WCAG tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa; axe-core 4.13.0. A node is "core" when the same rule fires on the same selector, screen, language and mode with every /assets/institutional_theme/ request blocked; otherwise "theme".
